name: Toushino Miyawa
source: A classmate, the greatest admirer, the number one fan and the self-styled stalker of [url=http://vndb.org/c1789]Tomo[/url]. She holds lesbian desires towards the person she believed to be a girl just like her. Though she poses a great danger towards him, she is contented of being just a stalker and has no intention of crossing the line... which unknowingly keeps her beloved away from triggering the curse.
